 Steelers Soured On Calvin Ridley; Team Pursued Brian Thomas Jr., Josh Downs
 By Ben Levine |
 at November 10, 2026 6:12 pm 
 The Steelers were mentioned as a primary suitor for wide receivers ahead of the trade deadline. The organization didn’t end up making a deal, but the front office was still plenty active in trade talks. Per Gerry Dulac of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette , the team had trade discussions about three WRs: Jaguars WR Brian Thomas Jr. , Colts WR Josh Downs , and Titans WR Calvin Ridley .
 We heard previously that the Steelers were pursuing both Thomas and Downs. The team’s interest in Thomas didn’t lead to a deal, and the former first-round pick ended up sticking in Jacksonville through the trade deadline. The Steelers were also often mentioned as a Downs suitor , but the Colts ended up sending the disgruntled wideout to the Chiefs .
 While the Steelers were previously mentioned as a potential landing spot for Ridley, this is the first time the organization has been definitively connected to the veteran WR. Considering the player’s age, salary, and declining role in Tennessee, he presumably would have been the least expensive of Pittsburgh’s receiver targets. However, Mark Kaboly says the Steelers “soured” on Ridley following his recent incident at Nashville International Airport .
 Once signed to lead the Titans’ WR corps, Ridley has fallen down the depth chart in recent years. He finished with 1,017 receiving yards during his first year in Tennessee, but he followed that up with only 303 receiving yards in seven games in 2025. His role has completely fallen off in 2026; in seven games, he’s hauled in only six catches while appearing in about half of his team’s offensive snaps.
 Considering that production, Ridley surely would have been an ancillary piece in Pittsburgh. The Steelers could use some extra depth as they await the return of Michael Pittman , although the team has gotten some solid production from rookie Germie Bernard opposite D.K. Metcalf .
